reason: A is more directly matched to oxidizing, water/NO-containing automotive exhaust: a ceria overcoat can plausibly provide oxygen-storage/redox functionality and inhibit sintering, although excessive coverage could block alloy sites. B extrapolates fuel-cell ORR evidence to gas-phase exhaust, emphasizes dissolution/leaching that is not the principal aging mode there, and assumes nitrogen and metal–nitrogen bonds will remain stable under hot oxidizing steam without establishing that critical premise.
